task.title: Run your first migration
task.shortdesc: Migrate the sample TPU map and read its report. It takes about ten minutes, most of it waiting for the run.

prereq.p: A Google account that the deployment allows. To run on your own computer instead, see .

info.p: Each DITA map in the corpus is listed with its last run.

step.cmd: On the tpu/tpu.ditamap row, choose migrate and select Start run.

stepresult.p: The run appears as queued, then running.

step.cmd: When the run finishes, open it.

info.p: The run detail lists every topic with its result for each check.

result.p: The gate passes when no topic fails a check. A topic that fails is either fixed by a proposed rule or sent to a writer. See .
